Formulas.Description: A non refuelable reactor, Generates power for a ship

Properties.Name: Mass
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Mass of the reactor'

Properties.Name: Power Output
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'in Kw'

Properties.Name: Fuel Consumption
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Fuel Consumption kg per second at Max Output'

Properties.Name: Lifetime
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'How long this reactor will be useful for'

Properties.Name: DB
Properties.PropertyFormula: AtbConstrArgs('fissile-fuels', PropertyValue('Fuel Consumption'), 'electricity', PropertyValue('Power Output'), PropertyValue('Lifetime'))

Properties.Name: Mass
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Mass of the bank'

Properties.Name: Energy Storage
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Energy capacity of this part'

Properties.Name: C-Rate
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Lithium-ion pack: charges or discharges fully in about an hour (1C)'

Properties.Name: Charge Rate
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Highest power the battery takes in: capacity times C-rate, per hour'

Properties.Name: Discharge Rate
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Highest power the battery gives out: capacity times C-rate, per hour'

Properties.Name: Round-trip Efficiency
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Share of the charging energy that comes back out. The loss is taken while charging'

Properties.PropertyFormula: AtbConstrArgs('electricity', PropertyValue('Energy Storage'), PropertyValue('Charge Rate'), PropertyValue('Discharge Rate'), PropertyValue('Round-trip Efficiency'))

Formulas.Description: A radioisotope thermoelectric generator: Pu-238 decay heat through thermocouples. No moving parts and no refuelling; output falls by half every 87.7 years as the isotope decays.

Properties.Name: Mass
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Mass of the generator'

Properties.Name: Fuel
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Isotope heat source: 15% of the mass, as in a GPHS-RTG'

Properties.Name: Heat per kg
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Decay heat of Pu-238 when new, about 0.57 kW per kg'

Properties.Name: Efficiency
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Thermoelectric conversion: 6% at level 0, +0.5 points per Conductors level'

Properties.Name: Power Output
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Output when new: fuel x heat per kg x efficiency. Halves every half-life.'

Properties.Name: Half-life
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Pu-238 half-life'

Properties.Name: Output after 20 years
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Output once the isotope has decayed for 20 years'

Properties.Name: Watt per kg
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Specific power when new'

Properties.Name: Structural Material
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Structural material amount'

Properties.Name: Thermoelectric Materials
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Amount of Material used for energy conversion'

Properties.Name: Electrics and wiring
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Structural material amount'

Formulas.Description: Hydrogen or methane fuel cells: electricity from the ship's tank propellant, burnt with its own oxidiser. Non-nuclear power for early ships, at a fuel cost of about half a kilogram per kWh.

Properties.Name: Mass
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Mass of the fuel cell stack and its plumbing'

Properties.Name: Fuel Type
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'The tank propellant the cells burn'

Properties.Name: Specific Power
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Electric output per kg of stack, about 60 W/kg (the Shuttle cells were 7 kW at 118 kg)'

Properties.Name: Cell Efficiency
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Share of the propellant chemical energy turned into electricity'

Properties.Name: Power Output
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Maximum electric output'

Properties.Name: Fuel per kWh
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Propellant burnt per kWh: 3,600 kJ / (chemical energy per kg x efficiency)'

Properties.Name: Fuel Burn Rate
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Propellant burnt per second at full output'

Properties.Name: DB
Properties.PropertyFormula: AtbConstrArgs(PropertyValue('Fuel Type'), PropertyValue('Fuel Burn Rate'), UniqueID('electricity'), PropertyValue('Power Output'), 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)

Formulas.Description: A more powerful reactor that heats water to steam and passes it through a turbine

Properties.Name: Mass
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Mass of the reactor'

Properties.Name: Output vs Efficency
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Percent of mass taken up by the generator vs the core, larger generator is more efficent but less output'

Properties.Name: CoreMass
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Mass of the Core including fuel and shielding'

Properties.Name: GennyMass
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Mass of the Turbine and generator'

Properties.Name: FuelMass
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'As a percentage of core mass'

Properties.Name: Heat per kg
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Heat output per kg of fuel. 1/12 kW/kg makes the default 2 tonne plant 50 kW of heat, 15 kW electric at 30% conversion. Larger cores run hotter (x (Mass / 2 t)^0.3, as space reactors gain specific power with size), and each Reactor Power Density level multiplies it.'

Properties.Name: Core Efficiency
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Efficiency turning fuel into heat'

Properties.Name: Generator Efficiency
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Share of the core heat the turbine and generator turn into electricity: Reactor Power Conversion, 30% at level 0. The rest is waste heat.'

Properties.Name: Fuel Burn Rate
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Fuel Consumption kg per second at Max Output'

Properties.Name: CoreOutput
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Heat output of the reactor'
Properties.PropertyFormula: PropertyValue('FuelMass') * PropertyValue('Heat per kg') * PropertyValue('Core Efficiency')

Properties.Name: GeneratorOutput
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Electricy output of the generator'

Properties.Name: DB
Properties.PropertyFormula: AtbConstrArgs(UniqueID('fissile-fuels'), PropertyValue('Fuel Burn Rate'), UniqueID('electricity'), PropertyValue('GeneratorOutput'), PropertyValue('FuelDuration'))
